profile: Independent SAP S/4HANA training for training providers and corporate teams. Focus: Materials Management and procurement, practical exercises, process understanding and certification preparation. Previous SAP SE experience was in solution sales; it is not presented as implementation project experience.

portfolio.scope: Procurement from requisition to invoice; sources of supply, contracts, scheduling agreements, inventory management, physical inventory and consumption-based planning. Customizing topics include organizational structures, master data, valuation and account determination.
portfolio.basis: Focus confirmed by the operator; topic scope described in the October 2026 corporate CV.

portfolio.scope: The October 2026 corporate CV describes order processing, availability checks, delivery, billing, pricing and related customizing. The requested course, release, depth and delivery commitment are agreed individually.
portfolio.basis: Documented topic experience; no blanket commitment to every SD academy or expert course.

portfolio.scope: Accounting effects of goods movements and invoices, material valuation and billing integration. Standalone FI course delivery is agreed only after its scope has been confirmed.
portfolio.basis: FI integration in the October 2026 corporate CV; FI user certification inspected.

logistics: Course version, learning goals, duration, prerequisites, delivery format, region, dates, time zone, SAP system access and responsibility for software and training-material licences are agreed for each engagement. An SAP course code alone does not confirm availability or an included system licence.

qualifications.title: SAP P2WTTT - People to Work
qualifications.detail: Attendance documented for November 26-27, 2024. The document is an attendance confirmation; it is not described as authorization to act as an official SAP training partner.

qualifications.title: AEVO trainer aptitude examination
qualifications.detail: Passed on October 8, 2014; certificate from IHK München und Oberbayern inspected.

qualifications.title: SAP User Certifications - with distinction
qualifications.detail: Material Management and Sales & Distribution with SAP S/4HANA 2021 (2023); Financial Accounting with SAP S/4HANA 2023 (2025).

qualifications.title: Professional certifications earned in 2024
qualifications.detail: SAP Certified Application Associate - SAP S/4HANA Sourcing and Procurement; SAP Certified Application Associate - SAP S/4HANA Sales 2021. The available certificates show an expiry date of March 31, 2025; current renewal status has not been verified.

education: B.Sc. Business Administration, Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin (2021), as stated in the corporate CV.
exam_statement: Mario reports a first-attempt pass rate above 98% from his own tracking over the three years preceding his November 2, 2026 statement. Exact date boundaries, passed/attempted counts and coverage of unknown results are not available; the rate has not been independently recalculated.
participant_statement: Mario estimates more than 300 participants. Whether this counts distinct people or course participations remains unresolved; it is not a verified count of unique people or consultants.

author_bio.en: Mario Bahunek is an independent SAP S/4HANA trainer focused on Materials Management and procurement. His October 2026 corporate CV also describes SD training topics and FI integration.
author_bio.de: Mario Bahunek ist unabhängiger SAP-S/4HANA-Trainer mit Schwerpunkt Materialwirtschaft und Einkauf. Sein Firmen-CV vom Oktober 2026 beschreibt außerdem SD-Trainingsinhalte und FI-Integration.
